# Stop rule replay 2026-10-15-crawl-stop

Replays the `webclaw-query` crawls with the rule "stop once the best page so far rates at least F and the K pages after it rate no higher". Each cell: answers kept / answers the full crawl found, mean pages fetched (budget 50). A stop keeps the 3 pages in flight. Bold: the rule `--stop-when-answered` ships, K=8, F=0.8.
